title: Library path of the project's Delphi
summary: index reads the library path, IDE variables and $(BDS) from the BDS key of the project's target; a missing key falls back to 37.0 with a one-line note
intro: Read this when a project targets an older Delphi: index follows it for the library path too, so units only that Delphi's Search Path names join the closure and their callers bind.
